text.headline: Koutian Wu — Researcher Chronicle
text.text: USTC undergraduate, Shenzhen X-Institute fellow, NSF NCAR visiting scholar, and now a UT Austin PhD student building explainable AI inside physics-based land surface models.

text.headline: China — pre-university years
text.text: Koutian Wu's formation in China before USTC.

text.headline: USTC: B.S. with Honors, Geological and Earth Sciences
text.text: Entered the University of Science and Technology of China in Hefei in 2020, completing a B.S. with Honors in Geological and Earth Sciences in 2024.

text.headline: Founder & President — USTC Xingyun Poetry Club
text.text: Founded the USTC Student Xingyun Poetry Club at age 17 — second youngest student club president in USTC history. Grew membership to 1,197+ and ran 25+ cultural events.

text.headline: Student Fellow — Shenzhen X-Institute
text.text: Two-and-a-half years as a Student Fellow at the Shenzhen X-Institute, the Shenzhen Municipal Government / Tsinghua University talent program. Concurrent with USTC.

text.headline: Visiting Scholar — NSF NCAR
text.text: Six months at the National Center for Atmospheric Research in Boulder, Colorado, working with Han-Li Liu's WACCM-X group on the 2022 Hunga–Tonga eruption signature in the MLT region.

text.headline: AGU 2023 — Hunga–Tonga / WACCM-X poster
text.text: Wu, K., Liu, H.-L., Yi, W., & Xue, X. (2023). Perturbations by the 2022 Hunga-Tonga Volcano Eruption in the MLT Region. AGU Fall Meeting Abstracts, SA33B-2892.

text.headline: JGR: Space Physics — Mengcheng meteor radar paper
text.text: Wu, K., Yi, W., Xue, X., Reid, I. M., & Lu, M. (2024). Diurnal and seasonal variations of meteor speed and arrival angle observed by Mengcheng meteor radar. JGR: Space Physics, 129(10), e2024JA032767.

text.headline: Reviews of Geophysics and Planetary Physics — Space Physics education report
text.text: Wu, K., Xu, X., Jiang, J., & Shen, A. (2024). A summary report on the Space Physics practical education in 2022. Reviews of Geophysics and Planetary Physics, 55(1), 144–152.

text.headline: Graduate Teaching Assistant — UT Austin
text.text: Graduate Teaching Assistant at UT Austin, 2024–2025.

text.headline: Industry internships: PineAI and Beijing ZaiwenAI
text.text: AI Agent Evaluation Engineer at PineAI; Full-Stack LLM Developer at Beijing ZaiwenAI Technology Co., Ltd.

text.headline: People's Daily Overseas Edition profile
text.text: 从'零'到'一' 破界创新（学创天地） — People's Daily profile of Shenzhen X-Institute students, including Wu's path from feeling directionless to interdisciplinary research.

text.headline: Tsinghua University news republication
text.text: Tsinghua University's official news portal republished the People's Daily piece in 2025.

text.headline: Joins UT Austin as Graduate Research Assistant
text.text: Joined the Jackson School of Geosciences at UT Austin as Graduate Research Assistant in August 2024; PhD with advisor Zong-Liang Yang.

text.headline: AMS 2026 — Plant hydraulics in Noah-MP
text.text: Wu, K., Li, L., Rempe, D., Matheny, A. M., Mbarak, M., & Yang, Z.-L. (2026). How Does Integrating Plant Hydraulics Improve Noah-MP Land Surface Model. 106th AMS Annual Meeting.

text.headline: Mango TV / Hunan TV — 《夺金2026》Episode 1
text.text: Featured in Episode 1 of 《夺金2026》(Gold Rush 2026), a Mango TV / Hunan Television program following university student entrepreneurs in Austin, Texas. Wu appears around 25:25.

text.headline: NSF NCAR Allocation UTAA0012 — Project Administrator
text.text: Project Administrator on NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012: Explainable AI for Improving Physics-Based Noah-MP Land Surface Modeling of Plant–Rock–Water Interactions. Significant HPC time on the NSF NCAR Derecho-GPU supercomputer.
